headline: 愛丁堡藝穗節前輩傳心法
context: 愛丁堡藝穗節期間，一群喜劇老將把生存心法傳給第一次登台的新人——怎麼面對緊張、負評、賣不出票。受訪者包括五十多歲才開始說單口的 Fiona Allen，和六十多歲首次參加藝穗節的老牌藝人 Joe Pasquale。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: How do you deal with nerves or bad reviews? What if you don’t sell any tickets? For debutants, the list of potential worries is huge. So we paired a few up with veterans to talk past mistakes, coping strategies – and the odd celebrity encounter Binge on the fringe: the must-see shows at Edinburgh 2026 Explore the rest of our coverage of the Edinburgh festival 2026 Everyone has to start somewhere – even at the Edinburgh festival fringe. But what made Smack the Pony actor Fiona Allen take up standup in her 50s? Why is veteran TV entertainer Joe Pasquale making his fringe debut in his 60s in an ensemble comic play? How many taboos will newcomer Sepideh Kaav, a Berlin-based Iranian comic in her early 30s, break by talking about sex? And what will the 78-year-old, seven-time Edinburgh veteran Gyles Brandreth make of debutant Brandy Bex, a 50-year-old NHS nurse performing in drag? We paired six fringe stalwarts with relative newcomers to compare their hopes, fears and survival tactics for this year. Continue reading...
sources.title: ‘If you’d done that in the 90s, you’d have been torn to pieces!’: comedy icons share their Edinburgh fringe survival tips with first-timers

claim_trace.source_title: ‘If you’d done that in the 90s, you’d have been torn to pieces!’: comedy icons share their Edinburgh fringe survival tips with first-timers

thread_text:
愛丁堡藝穗節（Edinburgh Fringe）上，喜劇老將和第一次登台的新人配對聊天，分享生存心法：怎麼面對怯場、負評、票賣不出去。受訪者包括五十多歲才開始說單口喜劇的 Fiona Allen、六十多歲首次登上藝穗節的老牌藝人 Joe Pasquale，還有來自柏林的伊朗裔新人 Sepideh Kaav。

本則來自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 9 日發佈的專題。
threads_text:
愛丁堡藝穗節（Edinburgh Fringe）這邊，有人安排喜劇老將跟第一次登台的新人配對聊天，把生存心法傳下去——怯場怎麼辦、被寫負評怎麼辦、票一張都賣不出去怎麼辦。名單裡有五十多歲才開始說單口喜劇的 Fiona Allen，有六十多歲第一次參加藝穗節、卻已是資深電視藝人的 Joe Pasquale，也有來自柏林的伊朗裔新人 Sepideh Kaav。

本則來自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 9 日發佈的專題，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
voice_text: 愛丁堡藝穗節，老將們開始帶新人了。第一次上台的表演者，煩惱一大串——怯場怎麼辦、被寫負評怎麼辦、票一張都賣不出去怎麼辦。於是有人安排新人跟前輩配對聊聊。裡面有五十多歲才開始說單口喜劇的 Fiona Allen，也有六十多歲第一次登上藝穗節的老牌藝人 Joe Pasquale。
